findings.problem: The proof repeats, nearly line for line, the proof of `analyzingCoefficient_self_pairing` in AnalyzingCoefficients.lean (lines 40–75). That proof has the same three parts. (1) A per-term `hterm` unfolds `PiLp.inner_apply`/`RCLike.inner_apply`/`Finset.mul_sum` and rewrites with `area i * a i k = ∫ …`. (2) A `hInt` obtained from `const_mul`, then `simp_rw [← integral_const_mul]`, `integral_finsetSum` twice with `integrable_finsetSum`, and `Finset.sum_congr`, to swap sum and integral. (3) A pointwise `integral_congr_ae` step with `Finset.sum_comm` and a final `ring`. The target is the strictly more general statement: arbitrary `c`, subset `S`, and `area i ≠ 0` only on `S`. The self-pairing result is the special case `S = univ`, `c = analyzingCoefficient …`. So the sum–integral interchange and the inner-product expansion are maintained in two places. The target's `harea` block also re-proves `analyzingCoefficient_mul_area`, which already exists but demands `∀ i, area i ≠ 0`. That is why the target could not reuse it.
findings.proposed_change:
1. In AnalyzingCoefficients.lean, weaken `analyzingCoefficient_mul_area` to take a pointwise hypothesis `(hi : area i ≠ 0)` instead of `ha : ∀ i, area i ≠ 0`. The proof is unchanged, with `exact_mod_cast hi`. Update the one use in `analyzingCoefficient_self_pairing` to `(ha i)`.
2. Move the general statement `finite_analyzing_pairing` (with `I` not required to be `Fintype`; use `omit` as the file already does) into AnalyzingCoefficients.lean before `analyzingCoefficient_self_pairing`. Its `hterm` becomes `simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_; rw [← analyzingCoefficient_mul_area μ area wave g (ha i hi) i k]; ring`.
3. Rewrite `analyzingCoefficient_self_pairing` as a corollary. Take `h := finite_analyzing_pairing μ area wave g (analyzingCoefficient μ area wave g) Finset.univ (fun i _ => ha i) (fun i _ k => hint i k)`. Note `diagonalSynthesis wave c z = ∑ i ∈ univ, toLp 2 (fun k => c i k * wave i k z)` by `ext`/`simp [diagonalSynthesis, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]`. Convert the right side with `inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K` and `Complex.ofReal_sum/mul/pow` (the existing `hnorm` step). Then use `h.symm`.
4. Keep AnalyzingBilinear.lean as a thin re-export (or delete it and fix the three importing files) so downstream names are unchanged.
findings.benefit: The Fubini/sum–integral interchange and the inner-product expansion are proved once instead of twice, about 35 duplicated lines. Both theorems then derive from one general lemma, so any later change (e.g. to the definition of `analyzingCoefficient` or the integrability hypotheses) is made in one place. The duplicated `area * (area⁻¹ * ·)` cancellation is also removed. A reader sees directly that the self-pairing is the diagonal case of the general duality.
